name: Futari o Musubu Ao
source:
Hina, a girl prone to negative thinking, crosses paths with Nami, a girl who radiates an air of mystery. The key to the destiny awaiting these two girls lies within a certain blue telephone.

Will she be able to defy fate and seize her own happiness? Or will she drown in the depths of Nami's love?

This is the story of two girls, woven together by a blue thread.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8442]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
容易产生消极想法的女孩希娜与散发着神秘气息的女孩娜美相遇。等待这两个女孩命运的钥匙就藏在一部蓝色的电话里。

她能否战胜命运，抓住属于自己的幸福呢？或者她会淹没在娜美的爱的深处吗？

这是两个女孩的故事，由一根蓝线编织在一起。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8442]Novelgame[/url]]
